261124 letter-fall-stamp: before / after

Before: git HEAD (0fe8bd7). After: working tree on 0fe8bd7. Local Release publish, 1366x768 and 390x844; red boxes mark changed pixels.

  • The letter fall (x in the top bar, or 30 s idle on home) no longer takes the vYYMMDD stamp: it stays in its pill at full contrast, above the falling letters (close-up). Before, its letters fell with the rest and the pill stood empty.
  • Every other letter still falls; the pile and the backdrop differ run to run, so those red boxes are noise. On a phone the stamp is the last thing in the page, below this viewport.
